referenceName: Digital-first veterinary membership with a care-location index

source.name: Modern Animal official website
source.sourceType: official direct veterinary-business website, captured in Playwright Chromium
source.rightsEvidence: Requester-attested clearance on 2026-09-29 covers retaining the paired desktop/mobile full-page captures, deriving a design prompt, and using these captures as internal pipeline-model visual references. No source-owner grant was supplied.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A digital-first veterinary membership experience pairs a slim utility header with a friendly pet-and-person opening and a nearby-clinic finder. The page alternates warm neutral editorial sections and muted blue feature fields. Care expectations unfold as a compact disclosure list, member stories and location names create proof and wayfinding, and service categories are introduced beside a large contextual image. Later chapters explain plan value, the care team and the companion app before a dense newsletter footer. Transfer the locator-first conversion, alternating page rhythm, human scale, and app-as-service chapter, not this company's brand, photos, claims, prices, testimonials, or exact palette. The original long-page capture contains a blank tail below its footer; that is not a signature and should not be reproduced.

heroGeometry.mode: split editorial opening with pet portrait and adjacent clinic locator
heroGeometry.viewport: compact utility header, one concise promise, locator visible in first screen

navigationGeometry.mode: slim wordmark bar with grouped service navigation and one booking action
navigationGeometry.mobile: compressed brand row with a direct booking control and menu disclosure

typography.scale: large but restrained opening with small uppercase wayfinding labels

palette.contrastIntent: gentle surfaces with unmistakable controls and strong body-text contrast

imageTreatment.mode: documentary owner-and-pet photography mixed with calm clinic interiors
imageTreatment.crop: large rectangular hero and alternating editorial crops
imageTreatment.focalPoint: human-animal interaction remains visible; keep text in a separate calm field

servicePresentation.pattern: short expandable care expectations followed by a compact service index
servicePresentation.interaction: one answer opens per row; service names remain visible and link to their own detail

ctaPlacement.primary: find a nearby clinic or book
ctaPlacement.early: locator embedded in the opening, before long-form proof

motion.primitive: horizontal member-story rail and small disclosure transitions
motion.library: native CSS or framework primitives; no source code transfer
motion.reducedMotion: show all story controls and disclosure content without timed movement

mobileRecomposition.strategy: stack the opening copy, locator, and photograph, then make each editorial module a single readable chapter
rules: keep booking or location lookup near the opening
turn the location list into accessible disclosures
replace carousels with touch-safe controls and visible items
do not preserve the captured blank footer tail

prohibitedPatterns: copying Modern Animal branding, logo, images, exact copy, reviews, prices, or business claims
duplicating its palette as a brand kit
reproducing the blank area beneath the source footer
using an app or membership claim when the client has not verified one

requiredSignatureElements.description: A location or care-finding action is part of the opening composition, when the client actually serves a locatable area.
At least two middle sections alternate between concise text and context imagery rather than repeating one card grid.
A short, accessible disclosure explains care options or visit expectations.

acceptanceChecks: The opening conversion action is visible without scrolling on desktop and quickly reachable on mobile.
The page rhythm alternates locator, care explanation, service discovery, and proof instead of repeating uniform cards.
A real client app or membership is mentioned only when confirmed by intake.
Every disclosure and story control works with keyboard and reduced motion.
No blank capture artifact, source identity, unsupported rating, price, service area, or claim is transferred.

review.notes: Official page returned HTTP 200 at both requested viewports. Full-page screenshots were inspected; no content-image failures remained in the cleaned capture. Browser logged a source-side querySelector error during scroll. Internal retention and model use remain requester-attested, not independently verified owner permission.
